title: Spec acceptance criterion 'analytics events still fire with unchanged section_ids' has zero test coverage at any level
evidence: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-form-stepper-f1.md:85: "- Given the stepper active, then `application_form_section_entered/completed/abandoned` still fire with unchanged `section_id`s (observer sees only shown sections)." | server/priv/static/form_stepper.js:518: "      sections[i].el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));" | `grep -n "dispatchEvent\|initBrowser\|section_completed\|Event(" scripts/js-tests/form_stepper.test.js` → no matches; `grep -rn "section_completed\|application_form_section" .claude/skills/form-bug-hunt/ .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` → no matches
detail: The r2 analytics-truth fix (input dispatch on gated Continue) lives in unexported initBrowser choreography; no unit test reaches it and no bug-hunt scenario asserts section funnel events. Deleting form_stepper.js:518 fails no test — a named r0 regression (blind-hunter #5) is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Pin the dispatch: export a testable seam (or happy-dom initBrowser test) asserting a gated Continue emits a bubbling input event, and/or add a bug-hunt assertion that application_form_section_completed fires per stepped section.

title: Error-reroute click wiring and preflight-hold wiring pinned only at predicate level; the single E2E scenario covers neither
detail: Spec acceptance row 'summary links switch steps + focus the field' and the r0 preflight dead-end fix hold only via pure-predicate pins; preventDefault→show→focus→scroll and the hold-and-scroll wiring are exercised nowhere. Same blind-spot class that let the r0 anchor double-prefix ship.
recommended_fix: Add an error-page stepper scenario (submit invalid, click a summary link into a hidden section, assert step switch + focus) and an oversized-file Continue-hold assertion, or a happy-dom test driving the click handler with a real #field-<key> href.

title: Spec claims 'no-op guards' unit-tested, but the form-missing and single-section guards have no test
detail: Only the marker-dimension no-op (shouldActivate) is pinned; the application-form-absent and <2-sections bail-outs inside unexported initBrowser are untested at any level. P3 defensive paths, but the spec's checked task overstates the delivered guard coverage.
recommended_fix: Either export a small predicate (e.g. needsStepper(sectionCount)) and pin it, or amend the spec task wording to 'marker no-op guards' so the record matches the delivered tests.
